Same-directory fsync+replace writes; rollback restores original bytes/modes or removes only newly introduced allowlisted destinations. Recovery verifies baseline files, tree inventory and previous selectors/health.

Terminal installed/rolled_back/rollback_failed/receipt_failed states; installed requires exact post-readback. Cleanup/recovery errors expose safe stage/type categories, not raw exceptions or environment secrets.

limitations_and_parent_actions: Parent must independently review these exact installer/test hashes, populate approval artifact_modes and CLI plan_mode, bind the final relocated payload/runtime review and separately frozen normalized baseline, then perform authorized production installation and GitHub update.

All systemd/process/HTTP boundaries were fixture-tested without invoking production hooks. Real systemd sandbox behavior, authenticated/public-domain browser flow and native quality12 inference remain parent-owned and unverified here.

The snapshot is immutable by installer convention and read-only permissions, not filesystem chattr protection against privileged root. SIGKILL/power-loss automatic recovery is not implemented; reconcile retained snapshot/receipt against exact installed state before retrying.

If terminal receipt persistence itself fails, returned status is receipt_failed and applied=false, but application files may already be installed. The durable prior receipt can remain archived; reconcile rather than treating this as a successful or automatically rolled-back deployment.
Rollback intentionally retains persistent shared-lock infrastructure and may leave empty newly created source directories. It does not delete production data or replace the shared lock inode.

The installer only proves a reviewed source/configuration transaction, not acoustic voice quality or end-to-end inference. Quality12/sample acceptance belongs to existing accepted evidence and the parent's relocated native preflight.
